title.zh-TW: 對話裡的網址和檔案連結都能順手點開
title.en: URLs and File Links in Chat Open Effortlessly

body.zh-TW:
在聊天區貼上網頁地址或整理本機文件，過去常遇到連結無法直接開啟的狀況。現在自己打進對話的網址會帶上點擊樣式，外觀跟助手回覆裡的完全一樣。

切換到 Pretty 模式閱讀時，將網址集中列在文章末端的參考式連結，顯示效果也跟直接寫在句子裡的行內連結相同。

就算畫面上正跳出需要確認的卡片，按住 `Cmd` 鍵點擊或用 `Ctrl+click`，照樣可以直接開啟連結。

若路徑裡含有 `%20` 空白編碼，點擊檔案連結現在會打開正確的檔案，不會再誤報找不到檔案。
body.en:
Pasting web addresses or organizing local files in chat used to leave you with links you could not open directly. Now URLs typed in user messages appear as styled clickable links matching assistant links.

When reading in Pretty mode, reference-style links that gather URLs at the end of a message display the same as inline links written directly in a sentence.

Even when the confirmation card is visible on screen, holding `Cmd` and clicking or using `Ctrl+click` still opens links directly.

If a path contains `%20` space encodings, clicking the file link now opens the correct file instead of falsely reporting it missing.

items.original:
Pretty mode shows reference-style links the same as inline links
URLs typed in user messages appear as styled clickable links matching assistant links
`Cmd` or `Ctrl+click` opens links even when the confirmation card is visible
File links containing %20 spaces open the correct file instead of reporting it missing

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式 /mcps 補上來源與工具摘要
title.en: Minimal-Mode /mcps Adds Server Source and Tool Summaries

body.zh-TW:
開著精簡模式用 `/mcps` 指令查閱已接上的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）清單，以前畫面往往只看得出名字。想確認手邊連了哪幾個外掛服務、它們能做什麼，現在清單會直接標出每個伺服器的來源位置，並附上各自提供的工具摘要。

⟦翻看插座面板時，以前只看到一排插孔卻不知誰接哪條線；現在每個接頭旁都會寫明來源電器跟用途。⟧
body.en:
When checking the list of connected MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers with `/mcps` in minimal mode, the screen used to show only names. If you want to verify which external services are connected and what they can do, the list now labels each server's source location along with a summary of the tools it provides.

⟦When checking a power strip, you used to see only a row of outlets without knowing which cord belonged to what; now each plug is labeled with its source appliance and purpose.⟧

items.original: Minimal-mode `/mcps` list shows server source and tool summaries

title.zh-TW: 修正 Tasks 窗格文字在執行期間閃爍
title.en: Fix Tasks Pane Text Flickering While Work Is Running

body.zh-TW: 把工作交給背景的小幫手執行、一邊盯著 Tasks 窗格看進度，原本上面顯示子代理動態的文字會因為一直更新而閃個不停。這個問題已經修好，現在工作進行期間這段文字不會再跟著閃爍。
body.en: When you handed work off to a background helper and watched progress in the Tasks pane, the subagent activity text shown there used to flicker constantly as it updated. That issue is now fixed, so the text no longer flickers while work is running.

items.original: Tasks pane no longer flickers with changing subagent activity text while work is running

title.zh-TW: 雙擊思考區塊與列表空白處操作恢復正常
title.en: Double-Click on Thinking Blocks and Blank Row Areas Restored

body.zh-TW:
想用滑鼠收合對話裡的內容或調整版面，之前偶爾會碰到點兩下沒反應，或是輕輕一滑就變成反白選取文字的狀況。

現在對著思考區塊（AI 展示推理步驟的摺疊區）連點兩下，又可以正常把它收起來或再展開。

從每一列的空白處拖曳滑鼠，也不會再突然觸發選取文字，也保留原本點擊摺疊或展開的操作。
body.en:
When trying to collapse chat content or adjust the layout with a mouse, double-clicks occasionally stopped responding or a slight drag turned into highlighted text selection.

Now double-clicking a thinking block (the collapsible area where AI shows its reasoning steps) folds or expands it properly again.

Dragging from blank areas of rows no longer triggers a text selection, while preserving the original fold and unfold clicks.

items.original:
Double-click on a thinking block folds or expands it again
Dragging from blank areas of rows no longer starts a text selection and preserves fold/unfold clicks

title.zh-TW: 長檔案路徑縮短後仍看得出檔名或資料夾
title.en: Shortened Long File Paths Keep File or Folder Names Visible

body.zh-TW:
當你把視窗縮窄或進到深層目錄找檔案，原本太長的路徑一旦被截短，往往只剩開頭一串母資料夾、看不出目標是誰。

現在在狹窄欄位裡顯示長檔案路徑，縮短之後依然能辨認出原本的路徑。

切換資料夾選擇器、Persona Source 路徑、How-to Guides 提示與 `@` 檔案搜尋這四處畫面，路徑過長時也都會優先留住最後的資料夾或檔案名稱。

結尾帶有一條或多條斜線的路徑，現在同樣能正確縮短，讓最後一層資料夾名稱保持可讀。

⟦寄快遞在窄標籤上寫地址，以前只印出開頭的縣市區名卻切掉門牌號碼；現在就算欄寬有限，都會留住最後的收件位置。⟧
body.en:
When you narrow the window or dig into deep directories for a file, a truncated long path used to leave only a string of parent folders at the start without showing the target.

Now long file paths shown in narrow columns stay recognizable after shortening.

In four places—the change directory picker, Persona Source path, How-to Guides tip, and `@`-file search—overly long paths now prioritize keeping the final folder or file name visible.

Paths ending in one or more slashes now shorten correctly as well, keeping the final folder name readable.

⟦Picture writing a shipping address on a narrow label: previously only the city and district fit while the street number got cut off, whereas now the final destination always stays visible despite the tight width.⟧

items.original:
Long file paths shown in narrow columns stay recognizable
Change directory picker, Persona Source path, How-to Guides tip and `@`-file search keep the folder or file name visible when a path is too long
Paths ending in one or more slashes shorten correctly and keep the final folder name readable

title.zh-TW: 矮窄終端機上面板不閃退也不截斷提示
title.en: Panels Stay Crash-Free and Hints Intact on Short or Narrow Terminals

body.zh-TW:
把終端機視窗拉得很矮或很窄來對照其他畫面，以前打開搜尋面板容易直接當掉，連按鍵提示也會被硬生生切掉半個字。

現在終端機高度很矮時，打開檔案搜尋面板跟歷史提詞面板都不會再當掉。

在儀表板叫出 `@` 檔案選擇器，就算終端機視窗高度不到 10 列也能正常開啟不閃退。

窄終端機上的權限確認卡片，底下的按鍵提示不會再從英文單字中間被裁斷。

取消回合面板在空間變窄時，現在也會套用正確的文字顏色與刪節號。

⟦整理桌面上的便條紙，以前桌子一換小就整疊滑落或字跡被對折裁半；現在視窗縮得再矮再窄，該看的按鍵字樣都還在。⟧
body.en:
When resizing a terminal window very short or narrow to compare with other screens, opening the search panel used to crash right away and key hints got sliced mid-word.

Now the file-search and prompt-history panels no longer crash when the terminal is very short.

Calling up the `@` file picker in the dashboard now opens without crashing even on terminals shorter than 10 rows.

On narrow terminals, key hints at the bottom of permission cards are no longer cut off mid-word.

The cancel-turn panel now uses the correct text color and ellipsis when space gets narrow.

⟦Think of sticky notes arranged on a desk: a smaller table used to send the whole stack sliding off or fold the writing in half, but now all the key labels stay intact no matter how short or narrow the window gets.⟧

items.original:
The cancel-turn panel uses the correct text color and ellipsis when narrow
Key hints in permission cards are no longer cut off mid-word on narrow terminals
The file-search and prompt-history panels no longer crash on very short terminals
`@` file picker in the dashboard no longer crashes on terminals shorter than 10 rows

title.zh-TW: 選擇器與恢復工作階段卡片的顯示修復
title.en: Display Fixes for Pickers and Resume Session Cards

body.zh-TW:
翻找過去的對話紀錄或從清單挑選項目，過長文字折行、中文字被切半或反白只塗一半，都會讓選單看得很吃力。

恢復工作階段的卡片現在會把過長文字和刪節號留在同一行。

在工作階段選擇器裡看到多行提詞時，刪節號也會跟著顯示在同一列上。

訊息預覽跟選擇器列表遇到中文或全形這類寬字元時，整行文字不會再被截斷。

選擇器裡被選中的項目，現在反白會完整覆蓋整行高度。

在恢復選擇器裡用內容搜尋找到的結果，上方標題也變得更簡短。
body.en:
When browsing past conversations or picking items from a list, wrapped long text, halved wide characters, or half-filled highlights made menus hard to read.

Resume session cards now keep long text and their ellipsis on a single line.

Multi-line prompts in the session picker now show their ellipsis on the same row.

Message previews and picker rows no longer get cut off when encountering wide characters such as Chinese or full-width text.

Selected items in pickers now highlight their full row height.

Content-search results in the resume picker also appear under a shorter heading.

items.original:
Resume session cards keep long text and their ellipsis on a single line
Message previews and picker rows no longer get cut off by wide characters
Selected items in pickers highlight their full height
Content-search results in the resume picker appear under a shorter heading
Multi-line prompts in the session picker show their ellipsis on the same row

title.zh-TW: 擴充功能視窗大小與標籤通知調整
title.en: Extensions Modal Sizing and Label Notice Adjustments

body.zh-TW:
打開擴充功能管理視窗安裝或切換項目，以前框格常比別的視窗窄一截、結果通知也閃一下就消失。

擴充功能視窗現在會維持跟其他彈出視窗一樣的寬度，不會再自己縮窄。

視窗裡標示待處理動作的標籤，開頭字母也統一改成大寫。

操作擴充功能後跳出的結果通知，現在停留顯示的時間跟其他訊息一樣長。
body.en:
When opening the extensions modal to install or toggle items, the frame used to be noticeably narrower than other modals and result notices vanished in a flash.

The extensions modal now keeps the same width as other modals instead of shrinking narrower.

Pending action labels in the modal now consistently start with a capital letter.

Result notices shown after extension actions now stay visible as long as other messages.

items.original:
Pending action labels in the extensions modal start with a capital letter
Result notices after extension actions stay visible as long as other messages
The extensions modal no longer shrinks narrower than other modals

title.zh-TW: 設定與意見回饋視窗的排版和提示改善
title.en: Layout and Hint Improvements for Settings and Feedback Modals

body.zh-TW:
進到設定或意見回饋視窗調整選項時，如果說明文字太長被裁掉，或螢幕太小找不到關閉按鈕，操作很容易卡住。

設定裡的開關與意見回饋訊息，現在改用一致的標籤名稱。

在 `/settings` 裡遇到比較長的設定說明，現在都會完整收進視窗內，不再被邊界切掉。

終端機視窗太小時，意見回饋與設定視窗會直接顯示 `Esc` 鍵提示。
body.en:
When adjusting options in the settings or feedback modals, overly long descriptions getting cut off or not finding a close button on a small screen could easily leave you stuck.

Settings toggles and feedback messages now use consistent labels.

Long setting descriptions in `/settings` now fit completely within the modal without being cut off by the border.

When the terminal is too small, feedback and settings modals now show an `Esc` hint.

items.original:
Settings toggles and feedback messages use consistent labels
Feedback and settings modals show an Esc hint when the terminal is too small
Long setting descriptions in `/settings` fit within the modal without being cut off

title.zh-TW: 指令錯誤與重設匯出通知格式更清楚
title.en: Clearer Command Error and Reset/Export Notice Formatting

body.zh-TW:
執行指令失敗或重設偏好設定，畫面上彈出的提示字句若是寫法五花八門，往往要猜半天才看懂問題在哪。

操作失敗時的錯誤訊息現在會用單一句子帶出原因。執行 `grok -p --resume` 卻一併帶入其他旗標（執行指令時附加的參數開關）而出錯時，提示也比以前清楚。

重設設定跟語音功能出錯時跳出的浮動通知，現在採用一致的格式。

下 `/export` 匯出對話後看到的狀態訊息，樣式也跟其他通知對齊。

多個指令列子指令的輸出訊息，現在統一了標點符號與檔案路徑加引號的方式。
body.en:
When a command failed or preferences were reset, inconsistent prompt wording on screen often forced you to guess what went wrong.

Error messages for failed actions now include the reason in a single sentence. Errors when running `grok -p --resume` with other flags (extra switches passed when running a command) are also clearer than before.

Toast messages shown for settings resets and voice errors now follow a consistent format.

Status messages seen after exporting a conversation with `/export` also match the style of other notices.

Output messages across several CLI subcommands now use consistent punctuation and path quoting.

items.original:
`/export` status messages match the style of other notices
Toast messages for settings resets and voice errors follow a consistent format
Error messages for failed actions include the reason in a single sentence, and errors for `grok -p --resume` when other flags are present are clearer
Several CLI subcommand messages use consistent punctuation and path quoting

title.zh-TW: 歡迎與登入畫面的框線和提示文字調整
title.en: Updated borders and prompt text on welcome and sign-in screens

body.zh-TW:
每次打開工具準備完成帳號驗證，或看看有沒有新版更新，最先見到的幾個操作步驟都更整齊了。

歡迎畫面裡用來輸入授權 token（登入驗證用的令牌）的方框，現在改為圓角外框。

同一個畫面上的更新通知現在對齊方式一致。

歡迎畫面上幾項小提示跟標籤也換成更一致的用字。

登入步驟複製內容後的提示字句，現在固定顯示為 `"Copied!"`、`"Copy sent: verify paste"` 以及 `"Copy failed"`。
body.en:
Every time you open the tool to complete account verification or check for new updates, the first steps you see are now tidier.

The box on the welcome screen for entering your auth token (a credential for sign-in verification) now has rounded corners.

Update notices on the same screen now align consistently.

A few tips and labels on the welcome screen also use more consistent wording.

The messages shown after copying during sign-in now read `"Copied!"`, `"Copy sent: verify paste"`, and `"Copy failed"`.

items.original:
Auth token box on the welcome screen has rounded corners
Update notices on the welcome screen align consistently
A few welcome-screen tips and labels use more consistent wording
Sign-in copy messages read "Copied!", "Copy sent: verify paste", and "Copy failed"

title.zh-TW: 目標視窗與儀表板各區的文字樣式對齊
title.en: Aligned text and styling across goal windows and dashboard sections

body.zh-TW:
在主畫面、目標彈窗或精簡介面之間切換查看進度，原本同一種資訊在不同地方長得不太一樣，看久了容易混淆。

目標疊加視窗裡的待辦清單，現在的樣式跟主待辦窗格完全相同。

狀態列與目標視窗裡顯示的目標狀態標籤，兩邊用字也保持一致。

精簡模式下的計畫核准文字，現在跟全螢幕版本一模一樣。

儀表板底部的頁尾內距變得平均，滑鼠移到位置說明文字上時也會變亮。
body.en:
When switching between the main screen, goal modals, or the minimal view to check progress, the same information used to look different across views, which could easily get confusing.

Todo lists in goal overlays now match the styling of the main Todo pane.

Goal status labels displayed in the status bar and the goal modal now use consistent wording.

Plan approval text in minimal mode now matches the fullscreen version.

The dashboard footer now has even padding, and the location caption brightens on hover.

items.original:
Todo lists in goal overlays match the main Todo pane styling
Plan approval text in minimal mode matches the fullscreen version
The dashboard footer is padded evenly and the location caption brightens on hover
Goal status labels are consistent between the status bar and the goal modal

title.zh-TW: 檔案列表與溢出提示的數量顯示修正
title.en: Fixed item counts in file lists and overflow messages

body.zh-TW:
要看工具一口氣掃出多少檔案，數字一旦算錯或只寫個大概，就很難核對到底有沒有漏。

現在列表工具的每一行都會顯示正確的檔案與資料夾數量。

內容過多時的提示訊息，現在會正確區分英文單複數，並顯示精確的項目數量。
body.en:
When checking how many files the tool scanned at once, miscounted numbers or approximate counts make it hard to verify whether anything was missed.

List tool rows now show the correct number of files and folders.

Overflow messages now pluralize properly and display exact item counts.

items.original:
List tool rows show the correct number of files and folders
Overflow messages correctly pluralize and show exact counts

body.zh-TW:
載入中的三個點、終端機標題大小寫跟圖片尺寸的寫法，過去各處規格不一，現在整套版面的符號格式都整齊了。

載入提示與輸入框預留文字，現在改用統一的 Unicode 刪節號字元。

狀態訊息跟終端機標題也遵循一致的大小寫規則。

對話紀錄裡顯示沒有可重試項目的那一行，結尾不再加上句號。

圖片預覽疊加視窗顯示尺寸時，現在改用乘號標示。
body.en:
The three loading dots, terminal title capitalization, and image dimension formatting used to vary across views, and now symbol formatting is consistent throughout.

Loading messages and input placeholders now use a consistent Unicode ellipsis character.

Status messages and terminal titles also follow consistent capitalization rules.

The transcript line indicating there is nothing to retry no longer ends with a period.

Image preview overlays now use the multiplication sign when displaying dimensions.

title.zh-TW: 提問與計畫審核也會跳出終端機通知
title.en: Terminal notifications now fire for questions and plan approvals

body.zh-TW: 開著終端機在背景跑任務，有時 Grok 會停下來等你回答問題或確認下一步。原本權限請求會發送終端機通知，現在提問卡、MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）輸入卡與計畫審核卡也會發出同樣的通知。⟦跟在醫院候診一樣，原本開藥櫃檯會叫號，現在看診和檢查的櫃檯也會按鈴提醒你過去。⟧
body.en: When running tasks in the background in your terminal, Grok sometimes pauses to wait for your answer or confirmation on the next step. Previously, permission requests sent terminal notifications; now question cards, MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) input cards, and plan-approval cards send the same notification. ⟦Think of waiting at a clinic: previously only the pharmacy counter called your number, and now the exam and checkup desks ring a bell to call you over too.⟧

items.original: Question, MCP input, and plan-approval cards now send the same terminal notification as permission requests

title.zh-TW: 用 /resume 可邊打字邊搜尋工作階段內容
title.en: Search session contents as you type with /resume

body.zh-TW: 想接續幾天前的對話卻忘了標題，光看列表往往很難找。現在打開 `/resume` 選擇器後，只要直接打字就會即時搜尋工作階段的對話內容，找到符合的項目就能直接開啟。⟦翻舊筆記本時，以前得一頁頁翻找標題，現在直接按關鍵字查內文，找到那一頁就能立刻接續寫下去。⟧
body.en: When you want to pick up a conversation from a few days ago but forget its title, scanning the list alone can make it hard to find. Now, after opening the `/resume` picker, typing directly searches session conversation contents in real time, and you can open a match right away. ⟦Picture flipping through an old notebook: instead of scanning page by page for a heading, you look up keywords inside the text and immediately pick up writing on that page.⟧

items.original: The `/resume` picker now searches session contents as you type and lets you open a match

title.zh-TW: Skills 內文支援展開傳入的參數變數
title.en: Skills now expand passed argument variables in the body

body.zh-TW: 寫好一段常用的 Skill（可重複呼叫的指令範本）來幫忙檢查檔案，每次卻得換成不同目標。現在只要在 Skill 內文放入 `${ARGUMENTS}` 或 `${ARGUMENTS[N]}`，呼叫時填入的參數就會自動展開並套進內容裡。⟦像寄活動邀請函，以前每封都要手動改人名和時間，現在只要把欄位留空，寄出時就會自動填入對應內容。⟧
body.en: You may have written a handy Skill (a reusable instruction template you can invoke) to help check files, yet each run needs a different target. Now, simply place `${ARGUMENTS}` or `${ARGUMENTS[N]}` in the skill body, and any arguments passed when invoking it will automatically expand into the text. ⟦Sending out event invitations used to mean editing the name and time by hand on every card, whereas now you leave those blanks open and the matching details fill in automatically when sent.⟧

items.original: Skills now expand `${ARGUMENTS}` and `${ARGUMENTS[N]}` in the skill body

title.zh-TW: 子代理達輪次上限會交回成果並喚醒上層代理
title.en: Subagents hitting their turn limit now return work and wake the parent

body.zh-TW: 把繁瑣的任務派給子代理（被派出去分頭處理任務的助手）處理，最怕它做到一半達上限就沒下文。現在子代理一旦達到輪次上限，會先把做到目前的成果交回來，並喚醒派出它的上層代理。⟦請同事幫忙查資料，以前時間到了他沒主動回報就讓你在位子上乾等，現在時間一到他會立刻把整理好的內容交回來叫醒你。⟧
body.en: When you hand a tedious task to a subagent (an assistant dispatched to handle work separately), the worst part is having it hit its limit halfway through with no word back. Now, once a subagent hits its turn limit, it returns the work it has done so far and wakes the parent agent that dispatched it. ⟦Ask a coworker to look up some info: previously, when time ran out without them checking back in, you were left waiting at your desk, whereas now as soon as time is up they hand over what they gathered and wake you up.⟧

items.original: A subagent that hits its turn limit now returns its work and wakes the parent

title.zh-TW: grok inspect 的外掛統計與安全隱藏調整
title.en: Plugin counts and security hiding updates for grok inspect

body.zh-TW:
執行 `grok inspect` 盤點專案設定，現在會把內嵌外掛裡的 hook（特定事件發生時會觸發的小程式）與 MCP 伺服器一併算進統計數量。

在不受信任的資料夾裡執行 `grok inspect`，則會比照一般工作階段，隱藏外掛的 hook 與 LSP 伺服器（提供程式碼提示與檢查的語言服務）。
body.en:
Running `grok inspect` to inventory your project settings now includes hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) and MCP servers from inline plugins in the total count.

When running `grok inspect` inside an untrusted folder, it now hides plugin hooks and LSP servers (language services that provide code hints and checks), matching a regular session.

items.original:
`grok inspect` now counts hooks and MCP servers from inline plugins
`grok inspect` hides plugin hooks and LSP servers in an untrusted folder, matching a session

title.zh-TW: 斜線指令的提示、選取與錯誤回覆調整
title.en: Updates to slash command hints, selection, and error replies

body.zh-TW:
在輸入框敲下 `/` 呼叫內建指令或 Skill，從提示、選取到打錯字都有新反應。

斜線指令的自動補全選單現在會在每個指令名稱後方顯示參數提示。

在斜線選單裡輸入完整的 Skill 名稱，現在能穩定選到完全相符的那一項。

輸入未知或已停用的斜線指令，現在會直接收到回覆，不會被送給模型。
body.en:
Typing `/` in the input box to call a built-in command or Skill now brings new behavior for hints, selection, and typos.

Slash command autocomplete now shows each command's argument hint after its name.

Typing a full Skill name in the slash menu now reliably selects the exact match.

Entering an unknown or disabled slash command now gets a direct reply instead of being sent to the model.

items.original:
Slash command autocomplete now shows each command's argument hint after the name
Typing a full skill name in the slash menu now reliably selects the exact match
Unknown or disabled slash commands now get a direct reply instead of being sent to the model

title.zh-TW: /skills 清單操作與 Skill 名稱顯示改進
title.en: Improvements to /skills list controls and Skill name display

body.zh-TW:
想在對話裡快速叫出特定工具，或看一眼終端機就知道剛剛載入哪一項，這幾個順手度細節都調好了。

在 `/skills` 後面加上名稱，會直接開啟 Skills 分頁並篩選出該名稱。

在 `/skills` 清單裡按下 `Space` 可以摺疊分組，篩選標籤也不再被截斷。

讀取 Skill 時，終端機捲動紀錄與 Shell 標題會顯示它對外宣告的名稱，不再顯示資料夾名稱。

讀取 Skill 的標題在重新載入後，依然會保留這個對外宣告的名稱。
body.en:
To quickly pull up a specific tool in a conversation or tell at a glance in the terminal which one was just loaded, these usability details have been tuned.

Adding a name after `/skills` now opens the Skills tab filtered to that name.

Pressing `Space` in the `/skills` list now folds groups, and the filter label is no longer clipped.

When reading a Skill, the terminal scrollback and shell titles now display its advertised name instead of its folder name.

Skill-read titles keep this advertised name after a reload.

items.original:
`/skills` with a name now opens the Skills tab filtered to that name
Space in the `/skills` list now folds groups, and the filter label is no longer clipped
Skill reads now show the skill's advertised name instead of its folder name in the scrollback and shell titles
Skill-read titles keep the skill's advertised name after a reload

title.zh-TW: 對話進行中的排隊、取消與面板收尾修復
title.en: Fixes for queuing, cancelling, and panel cleanup mid-turn

body.zh-TW:
在 AI 還沒跑完這一輪就先送出後續訊息、排入壓縮或急著按中斷，先前容易出現誤刪或卡住的狀況。

上一輪還在執行就先送出的後續提問，即使那一輪因為達到上限或重複呼叫工具而停下，也不再被丟掉。

一秒內按第二次 `Ctrl+C` 會進入準備離開狀態，不再誤取消下一條排隊中的提問。

前一輪還沒結束時先排進去的 `/compact`，現在能直接按 `Ctrl+C` 取消。

執行 `/rewind` 回退對話，會一併取消還在摘要中的壓縮作業。

停止面板會在它所屬的那一輪對話結束後關閉。
body.en:
Sending a follow-up message, queuing a compaction, or hitting interrupt before the AI finished the current turn previously risked accidental drops or getting stuck.

Follow-ups sent while the previous turn is still running are no longer dropped, even when that turn stops at its cap or on repeated tool calls.

Pressing `Ctrl+C` a second time within one second now arms quit instead of cancelling the next queued prompt.

A `/compact` queued while the previous turn was still running can now be cancelled directly with `Ctrl+C`.

Running `/rewind` to step back the conversation now also cancels a compaction that is still summarizing.

The stop panel now closes after the turn it belongs to finishes.

items.original:
Follow-ups sent into a running turn are no longer dropped when that turn stops at its cap or on repeated tool calls
A second Ctrl+C within one second now arms quit instead of cancelling the next queued prompt
The stop panel now closes when the turn it belongs to finishes
`Ctrl+C` now cancels a `/compact` that was queued while another turn was running
`/rewind` now cancels a compaction that is still summarizing

title.zh-TW: 工作階段標題與歷史預覽顯示修復
title.en: Fixes for session titles and history preview display

body.zh-TW:
翻找過去的對話紀錄或幫工作階段取名字，偶爾會撞見一串看不懂的符號或生不出標題。

工作階段標題不再夾帶原始色彩代碼或控制字元。

重新命名輸入框與歷史預覽畫面也拿掉了原始色彩代碼。

會把推理計算進輸出上限的模型，現在能完成工作階段標題的產生。
body.en:
Browsing past conversation logs or naming a session could occasionally run into gibberish symbols or fail to generate a title.

Session titles no longer include raw color codes or control characters.

The rename input and history previews also strip out raw color codes.

Models that count reasoning against the output limit now finish generating session titles.

items.original:
Session titles no longer show raw color codes or control characters
Rename input and history previews no longer show raw color codes
Session title generation now finishes on models that count reasoning against the output limit

title.zh-TW: 回覆與無頭模式輸出的換行分段更清楚
title.en: Clearer line breaks and paragraphs in replies and headless output

body.zh-TW:
讀 AI 回覆的文字或拿無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）的結果給別的程式接手，段落常黏成一大塊。

在無頭模式下使用 `plain` 或 `json` 格式輸出，呼叫工具之後會自動起新段落。

一般回覆也會保留單一換行符號作為斷行，不再全部併成同一段。
body.en:
When reading AI reply text or passing headless mode (an execution mode with no terminal window) output to another program, paragraphs used to clump into one big block.

When using `plain` or `json` format in headless mode, output now starts a new paragraph after tool calls.

Regular replies also preserve single newlines as line breaks instead of joining everything into one paragraph.

items.original:
Headless plain and json output now start a new paragraph after tool calls
Replies now preserve single newlines as line breaks instead of joining them into one paragraph

title.zh-TW: 單用 --fork-session 改為開新工作階段
title.en: Using --fork-session alone now starts a new session

body.zh-TW: 在終端機啟動 Grok 時，如果只帶了 `--fork-session` 參數，原本會直接失敗。現在單獨使用 `--fork-session` 會開啟一個新的工作階段。
body.en: When starting Grok in the terminal, passing only the `--fork-session` flag previously failed outright. Now using `--fork-session` on its own starts a new session.

items.original: `--fork-session` alone now starts a new session instead of failing

title.zh-TW: 雙擊思考區塊改為選取文字而非收合
title.en: Double-clicking a thinking block selects text instead of collapsing

body.zh-TW: 想複製 AI 思考過程裡的某個字詞，滑鼠連點兩下往往讓整塊內容突然收起來或展開。現在雙擊思考區塊會改為選取文字，不再切換摺疊狀態。
body.en: When trying to copy a word from the AI's thinking process, double-clicking often caused the entire block to suddenly collapse or expand. Double-clicking a thinking block now selects text instead of toggling its collapsed state.

items.original: Double-clicking a thinking block now selects text instead of folding or expanding it

title.zh-TW: Mac 裝有 OrbStack 可啟動限制網路沙盒設定檔
title.en: Network-restricted sandbox profiles start on Mac with OrbStack

body.zh-TW: 同一台電腦上既跑容器工具、又用沙盒（隔離執行環境）的人，先前可能遇過某些沙盒設定檔開不起來。現在 Mac 上就算裝了容器工具 OrbStack，套用限制網路的沙盒設定檔也能正常啟動。
body.en: People running both container tools and a sandbox (an isolated execution environment) on the same computer may have previously seen certain sandbox profiles fail to start. Now, even with the container tool OrbStack installed on a Mac, network-restricted sandbox profiles can start normally.

items.original: Network-restricted sandbox profiles now start on a Mac when OrbStack is installed

title.zh-TW: 修正儀表板派發框對 Enter 鍵動作的標示
title.en: Fix dashboard dispatch box label for Enter key action

body.zh-TW: 在畫面上點選某一列項目準備送出前，以前看旁邊的提示說明可能會被誤導。現在選取儀表板的項目後，派發框會正確標出按下 `Enter` 會執行的動作。
body.en: After selecting a row on screen, the adjacent hint text could previously mislead you as you prepared to submit it. Now, after selecting an item in the dashboard, the dispatch box accurately labels what pressing `Enter` will do.

items.original: Dashboard dispatch box now correctly labels what Enter does when a row is selected

title.zh-TW: 未修改的計畫修訂草稿送出後不再重複出現
title.en: Unchanged plan-revision drafts no longer reappear after sending

body.zh-TW: 送出計畫修訂草稿前如果沒改動任何文字，這份草稿送完還會再度跳回畫面上。這項異常已經修好，未修改的草稿送出後不再重複顯示。
body.en: If no text was edited before sending a plan-revision draft, that draft would pop back onto the screen afterward. This bug is fixed, and unchanged drafts no longer appear again after being sent.

items.original: An unchanged plan-revision draft is no longer shown again after it is sent

title.zh-TW: 點選隱藏的提問卡答案不再誤移游標
title.en: Clicking a hidden question-card answer no longer moves the caret

body.zh-TW: 滑鼠不小心按到畫面上收起來的區塊，打字位置原本會突然跑偏。這個問題已經修好，現在點擊隱藏的提問卡答案不會再移動游標。
body.en: Accidentally clicking a collapsed section on screen previously caused the typing position to jump away. This issue is fixed, and clicking a hidden question-card answer no longer moves the caret.

items.original: Clicks on a hidden question-card answer no longer move the caret

title.zh-TW: 語音聽寫處理上一段期間不再啟動新錄音
title.en: Dictation no longer starts a new recording while processing the last clip

body.zh-TW: 剛講完一句話、畫面還在消化前面那段聲音的空檔，如果不小心再觸發一次收音，以前會直接搶著開錄。這個問題已經修好，現在上一個語音聽寫片段還在處理時不會再啟動新錄音。
body.en: Right after finishing a sentence, while the screen was still processing the previous audio clip, accidentally triggering recording again used to start capturing immediately. This issue is fixed, and dictation no longer starts a new recording while the previous clip is still processing.

items.original: Dictation no longer starts a new recording while the last clip is still processing

title.zh-TW: 修正 grok update 清理舊下載檔時卡住的問題
title.en: Fix grok update hanging while cleaning up old downloads

body.zh-TW: 在終端機跑 `grok update` 更新版本，走到清理舊下載檔案那一步偶爾會停住不動。這個問題已經修好，現在清理舊下載時不會再卡住。
body.en: When running `grok update` in the terminal to update versions, the step that cleans up old downloaded files could occasionally stall. This issue is fixed, and cleaning up old downloads no longer hangs.

items.original: `grok update` no longer hangs while cleaning up old downloads

title.zh-TW: 開啟儀表板後首頁搜尋不再卡在搜尋中
title.en: Home-screen search no longer gets stuck on Searching after opening dashboard

body.zh-TW: 從首頁打開儀表板之後，首頁的工作階段搜尋欄原本會一直停在「Searching」狀態。這個問題已經修好，現在搜尋狀態不會再卡在搜尋中。
body.en: After opening the dashboard from the home screen, the home-screen session search bar previously stayed stuck in the "Searching" state. This issue is fixed, and the search status no longer gets stuck on Searching.

items.original: Home-screen session search no longer sticks on Searching after the dashboard opens

title.zh-TW: 工作階段還原失敗的分頁改為拒收新提問
title.en: Tabs with failed session restores now refuse new prompts

body.zh-TW: 重開程式後，如果某個視窗沒能成功接回先前的對話，你在裡面打字送出的訊息原本會像石沉大海一樣消失。現在遇到這種工作階段還原失敗的分頁，會改為明確拒收這則提問，不再默默丟棄。
body.en: After restarting the app, if a window failed to reconnect to its previous conversation, any message you typed and sent there used to vanish without a trace. Now, on a tab whose session failed to restore, the new prompt is explicitly refused rather than silently dropped.

items.original: A prompt typed on a tab whose session failed to restore is now refused instead of dropped

title.zh-TW: 工具搜尋列改為以 Search 開頭顯示
title.en: Tool search rows now start with Search

body.zh-TW: 在對話紀錄裡看到 AI 正在翻找資料時，找檔案跟找外部功能的提示行以前長得不太一致。現在工具搜尋列也改為以 `Search` 開頭，與檔案搜尋列保持相同格式。
body.en: When you see the AI looking up information in the conversation history, the lines for finding files and finding external features used to look inconsistent. Now tool search rows also start with `Search`, keeping the same format as file-search rows.

items.original: Tool search rows now start with Search, matching file-search rows

title.zh-TW: 修正 tmux 中 Grok 窗格的重繪問題
title.en: Fix Grok pane repainting issues in tmux

body.zh-TW: 用 tmux（把終端機分成多個窗格的工具）分割畫面來跑 Grok，以前按某些順序調整大小後，畫面會沒辦法正常更新。現在這些操作順序下，窗格都能正確重繪了。
body.en: When running Grok in a split screen using tmux (a tool that splits a terminal into multiple panes), the display previously failed to update properly after resizing in certain sequences. Now the panes repaint correctly under those operation sequences.

items.original: Grok panes in tmux now repaint correctly after certain resize sequences

entries: Open `/model` and `/context-window` dropdowns now update their rows and markers immediately when the session's model list changes

Double-tapping `Ctrl+O` in minimal mode on Apple Terminal no longer cancels the just-sent prompt

title.zh-TW: 模型清單與提示現在會即時正確顯示
title.en: Model lists and notes now update accurately in real time

body.zh-TW:
切換或查看可用模型，畫面上的清單和附註現在都跟得上最新狀態。

只要目前這個工作階段的模型清單有變，已經打開的 `/model` 與 `/context-window` 下拉選單，裡面的選項列和標記就會立刻更新。

你帳號裡可用的模型變動，或是從別的用戶端切換了模型，模型選擇器的清單也會即時刷新。

API 金鑰（連接外部服務的驗證密碼）的模型說明，現在只會出現在你實際看到的第一份清單，不會在彈出視窗底下又冒出來。
body.en:
When you switch or view available models, the on-screen lists and notes now stay up to date.

Open `/model` and `/context-window` dropdowns now update their rows and markers immediately whenever the current session's model list changes.

When the available models on your account change, or another client switches the model, the model picker updates its list live.

The model note for an API key (an authentication credential for external services) now appears only in the first list you actually see, and will not reappear underneath modals.

items.original:
Open `/model` and `/context-window` dropdowns now update their rows and markers immediately when the session's model list changes
Model picker now updates its list live when your account models change or another client switches the model
API-key model note now appears only in the first list the user actually sees and does not reappear under modals

title.zh-TW: grok update 從別份執行會提示後續做法
title.en: grok update explains next steps when run from another copy

body.zh-TW: 在終端機跑 `grok update` 準備升級版本，卻不確定有沒有動到原本在用的那一份嗎？現在只要它發現自己是從另一份副本執行，就會主動說明這個狀況，並告訴你接下來該怎麼做。⟦去連鎖門市辦會員續約時，以前不小心走到另一家分店櫃檯也不會特別提醒，現在對方會先點出你跑錯分館，再告訴你下一步怎麼辦。⟧
body.en: Running `grok update` in your terminal to upgrade, but unsure whether it touched the copy you normally use? Now, whenever it detects that it ran from a different copy, it explains what happened and tells you what to do next. ⟦Picture renewing a membership at a chain store: before, if you walked up to the wrong branch counter, nobody flagged it; now the clerk points out you are at a different branch and walks you through what to do next.⟧

items.original: `grok update` now explains when it ran from a different copy and what to do next

title.zh-TW: 打字與送出提問不會再閃退或誤取消
title.en: Typing and sending prompts no longer crash or misfire

body.zh-TW:
在輸入框打字、按鍵送出或排隊追問，這幾個中斷對話的問題都修好了。

切換到多行模式輸入內容，如果那一行剛好以反斜線「\」結尾，現在按 `Shift+Enter` 或 `Alt+Enter` 都能正常送出。

使用 Send-now 立即送出或連按兩次 `Enter`，第一下剛啟動的這一輪對話不會再被第二下取消。

視窗高度比較矮的終端機裡，輸入很長的回答也不會再突然閃退。

遇到權限詢問而選擇拒絕或取消後，原本已經排在後面等著送出的追問不會再平白消失。

在 Apple Terminal 的精簡模式連按兩次 `Ctrl+O`，也不會把剛剛送出去的提示取消掉。
body.en:
Several issues that interrupted conversations while typing in the input box, pressing keys to send, or queuing follow-ups are now fixed.

In multiline mode, if a line ends with a backslash "\", pressing `Shift+Enter` or `Alt+Enter` now sends it properly.

When using Send-now or pressing `Enter` twice, the second press no longer cancels the turn that the first press just started.

Typing long answers in a short terminal window no longer causes a sudden crash.

When you reject or cancel a permission prompt, follow-ups already queued behind it are no longer lost.

Double-tapping `Ctrl+O` in minimal mode on Apple Terminal no longer cancels the prompt you just sent.

items.original:
`Shift+Enter` (or `Alt+Enter`) in multiline mode now correctly sends a line that ends with a backslash
Send-now and double-Enter no longer cancel a turn that the first press just started
Typing long answers on short terminals no longer crashes
Queued follow-ups are no longer lost when a permission prompt is rejected or cancelled
Double-tapping `Ctrl+O` in minimal mode on Apple Terminal no longer cancels the just-sent prompt

title.zh-TW: 新的設定選擇不會再被舊寫入覆蓋
title.en: Newer settings picks are no longer overwritten by older writes

body.zh-TW: 剛挑好新的設定選項，過去如果遇到比較晚才寫進來的舊資料，新選項就會被蓋回去。現在這個問題已經修好，較新的設定選擇不會再被延遲的舊寫入覆蓋。⟦跟填表改通訊地址一樣，以前晚寄到的舊紙本會把你剛送出的新地址蓋掉，現在慢到的舊紀錄不會再蓋過新選擇。⟧
body.en: If you just picked a new setting and older data arrived late to write, your new pick used to get overwritten. That bug is now fixed, so a newer settings pick is no longer overwritten by a delayed older write. ⟦Think of updating your mailing address on a form: an older paper form arriving late in the mail used to overwrite the new address you just submitted, whereas now that late record no longer replaces your newer choice.⟧

items.original: A newer settings pick is no longer overwritten by a delayed older write

title.zh-TW: 中途登入按 Ctrl+N 不再多開工作階段
title.en: Pressing Ctrl+N during mid-session sign-in no longer opens an extra session

body.zh-TW: 你正在使用到一半，中途突然跳出需要重新登入的關卡。過去如果在這個畫面按了 `Ctrl+N`，等你之後完成登入，就會多開出一個額外的工作階段。現在這個問題已經修好，在途中的登入畫面按 `Ctrl+N` 不會再於登入後多開工作階段。⟦就像在銀行辦事中途被請去補驗證身分時，以前在等待畫面多按的那張號碼牌會在驗證完才跳出來多叫一號，現在不會多開一輪。⟧
body.en: Sometimes a sign-in prompt pops up mid-session asking you to sign back in. Previously, pressing `Ctrl+N` on that screen would open an extra session once you finished signing in. That is now fixed, so pressing `Ctrl+N` on a mid-session sign-in screen no longer opens an extra session after you sign in. ⟦A bank customer asked to step aside for an extra ID check used to see an extra ticket they pressed on the waiting screen call another number once verification finished, but now it no longer starts an extra round.⟧

items.original: Pressing `Ctrl+N` on a mid-session sign-in screen no longer opens an extra session after you later sign in

title.zh-TW: 極小終端機也能正常顯示歡迎畫面
title.en: Welcome screens display properly on tiny terminals

body.zh-TW: 分割螢幕排版，有時會把終端機（用文字打指令的視窗）壓到只剩 1 到 2 行高，或寬度不到 8 欄。過去在這種極小的尺寸下，歡迎畫面會沒辦法正確顯示，現在已經能正常呈現。
body.en: Split-screen layouts can sometimes shrink a terminal (a window for typing text commands) down to just 1 or 2 rows tall, or fewer than 8 columns wide. Previously, welcome screens failed to display properly at these tiny sizes, and now they appear normally.

title.zh-TW: 確認同意或信任後的後續點擊不再誤觸
title.en: Follow-up clicks after consent or trust no longer misfire

body.zh-TW:
你剛按下接受同意聲明或信任資料夾，手指緊接著又點了一下。過去這記後續點擊會在下一個畫面還沒畫出來之前就先作用，現在在下個畫面顯示出來前，這記點擊不會再搶先觸發。

⟦操作車站售票機的觸控螢幕時，以前點完確認多戳那一下，常會按到下一頁還沒跳出來的按鈕；現在新畫面沒出來前，多點的這一下不會再誤觸。⟧
body.en:
You just clicked to accept the consent notice or trust a folder, and your finger clicks once more right after. Previously, that follow-up click would act on the next screen before it was drawn. Now, it no longer triggers early before the next screen appears.

⟦When using a train station ticket machine touchscreen, an extra tap right after confirming used to hit a button on the next page before it even appeared; now, that extra tap will not misfire before the new screen shows up.⟧

items.original: A follow-up click after you accept the consent notice or trust a folder no longer acts on the next screen before it is drawn

title.zh-TW: Windows 內建 MinGit 改用原生安全通道
title.en: Bundled MinGit on Windows switches to native secure channel

body.zh-TW:
Windows 版的 Grok Build 裡本身就附帶了 MinGit（用來管理程式碼版本的精簡版工具）。

現在它進行 HTTPS 加密連線操作時，會使用 schannel（Windows 內建的安全通道）來處理連線。
body.en:
Grok Build on Windows includes bundled MinGit (a lightweight tool for managing code versions).

Now, when performing encrypted HTTPS connection operations, it uses schannel (the built-in Windows secure channel) to handle the connection.

items.original: Bundled MinGit on Windows uses the schannel backend for HTTPS operations
